spec_match.rationale: The probe now tests the gap-decoration surface (CSS.supports("row-rule", …) plus a computed rowRuleStyle of solid on the grid) instead of multicol column-rule, which is true everywhere. Chrome 158 paints the rules by default.

interactive.rationale: Line-width and gap sliders drive both panels and the zoomed pair through custom properties; a "cells touching / 8px gap" toggle (aria-pressed) shows the doubled border edge vs the rule panel having no gap to paint into.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The index card promises exactly this static side-by-side, zoomed probe and code comparison.

edge_cases.rationale: Gap 0 is demonstrated and explained (borders double to 2×width; gap rules paint nothing, confirmed by screenshot). Unsupported browsers get a no-gap-rules class that shows plain gaps and an honest pill.

references.rationale: Fixed 2026-10-04 (weekly hardening): the page now links https://chromestatus.com/feature/5157805733183488, matching its feature index — restoring invariant 3 and the fix-slugs self-heal. Verified by grep against the canonical id on the feature index.

conformance.rationale: The feature suite probes the real gap-decoration surface (row-rule longhands, rule shorthands, CSSOM round-trip) and honestly fails 6 of 8 in this browser — notably contradicting the page's own pill.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chrome for Testing 158.0.8127.36 via Node Playwright at 360x740 DPR3 touch and 1280x800 (chrome-devtools-mcp is unavailable in this cloud environment, so NOT DevTools-MCP verification). Both sliders (pointer and keyboard), both toggle buttons; readouts and notes measured from rendered geometry; 0 console errors, 0 failed requests.

telemetry_health.rationale: Reports showcaseTelemetry.support("row-rule", …) from the probe, plus shared runtime capture.

design_system.rationale: Variables throughout; code blocks get min-inline-size:0 and pre overflow-x:auto so the second block no longer escapes its track.

accessibility.rationale: Sliders are labelled with live <output>s, the toggle is a labelled group with aria-pressed, the pill is role=status, and a polite <output> readout describes the visual difference in text.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: 0px horizontal overflow at 360x740 DPR3 and 1280x800 (was overflowing even on desktop); all controls >= 44px under pointer: coarse.

openQuestions.title: Re-verify with chrome-devtools-mcp and inspect the accessibility tree
openQuestions.detail: The 2026-11-24 fix pass used Playwright (Chrome for Testing 158) because chrome-devtools-mcp is unavailable in the cloud environment.

summary: Fixed 2026-11-24: honest gap-decoration probe, interactive width/gap controls with measured readouts, contained code overflow, accessible controls.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive control panel without horizontal overflow; minimum touch target size
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Let grid tracks shrink (min-inline-size: 0) and scroll wide code inside its own box; size targets from a --target-size token, 44px under pointer: coarse.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: .code-block min-inline-size:0, pre overflow-x:auto, auto-fit control grid, 44px targets. 0px overflow measured at 360 and 1280.

guidanceConsulted.query: live readout for slider-driven visual comparison; toggle button aria-pressed
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Associate labels, expose toggle state with aria-pressed, and give visual changes a text equivalent via <output>/polite live region.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: labelled sliders with <output>, aria-pressed toggle group, role=status pill, polite readout.
